title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Thursday, 17 September 2026
description: Today: Google, Anthropic and OpenAI jointly unveil cyber AI safeguards as OpenAI pilots ad-supported Sponsored Agents; Tony Burke unveils Labor's migration overhaul as backpacker numbers hit a record high; a Mary Valley dairy family gets an 80-year lifeline; and Gold Coast Mayor Tom Tate doubles down on his disputed Mar-a-Lago dinner claim. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
